Answer: C
Reason: The images demonstrate Scimitar syndrome, characterized by a curvilinear vein on the right side running parallel to the right heart border (scimitar sign) and an abnormal systemic artery supplying the right lower lung (indicated by the arrow in the coronal CT). This condition is typically associated with right lung hypoplasia, which causes deviation of the mediastinum and heart to the right.
